author: August Strindberg
title: Fröken Julie
stated_source_edition: Swedish National Edition, based on the printing manuscript used for the censored first printing
editorial_note: Dialogue italics are removed, embedded stage directions are separated, and guillemet-like quotation marks are replaced by ordinary quotation marks.
assembly_note: The listed Runeberg pages are preserved and concatenated in listed order as one work-level corpus source.
processing_note: Visible text extracted from each preserved Runeberg HTML page and concatenated in listed order; entities decoded and block boundaries converted to newlines.
observed_format: UTF-8 plain text assembled from preserved HTML pages
rights_note: Project Runeberg states that it normally publishes Nordic literary works after copyright has expired under a life-plus-70 rule, and that copyright-protected Runeberg editions display an explicit warning; no such warning appears on this Fröken Julie edition. August Strindberg died in 1912. Independently, Australian Copyright Agency guidance states that published text is out of copyright in Australia when it was published before 1955 and the creator died before 1955. Fröken Julie was published in 1888 and Strindberg died in 1912, so the underlying literary work is out of copyright in Australia.
